title: carmichaelia carmichaeliae
intro: Carmichaelia carmichaeliae, commonly known as New Zealand spirea or karaka, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used in Maori medicine to treat various ailments, with health benefits including the potential to reduce inflammation and act as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Carmichaelia carmichaeliae include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
